name: Wycliffe-Zefania
scope: The Wycliffe Zefania import used by OpenBibleData. LAO is reviewed against the numbered English rendering of the Latin epistle by Michael D. Marlowe, also printed by Terence P. Noble. Other books preserve OBD's previous Copenhagen vul declaration, including its restrictions and supplement; they have not received a new whole-Bible collation. This is not a profile for every Wycliffe edition or every Latin LAO witness.

comparison.edition: Michael D. Marlowe, numbered English rendering accompanying J. B. Lightfoot's Latin critical text (1876). Use the explicitly numbered English column: the web Latin column omits a separate verse-17 label.
comparison.corroborationPages: Printed 678-680 (PDF pages 697-699), Wycliffe's Apocrypha, Terence P. Noble, 2013/2014; Latin-version English column credited to Marlowe.
comparison.method: Compared all 20 native verse boundaries by passage content. Verses 1-14 and 17-20 correspond by number. The list of qualities straddles native 15-16, requiring an atomic 15-16 group. Verse 17 is the peace clause. Verse 20 has a shorter reading about the Colossian letter; correspondence identifies that passage, not identical wording.

evidence.limits: Some Latin witnesses put peace in verse 16 and a holy-kiss greeting in verse 17 (https://www.rialto.unina.it/archivio/prorel/AdLaud/AdLaudlat-txt.htm). This profile does not assert equivalence to that greeting. No universal Latin LAO numbering is inferred from the common count of 20.
evidence.base: Materialized Copenhagen vul plus BOS mapping-supplement revision 2, preserving the pre-existing OBD declaration outside LAO. Copenhagen attribution and CC-BY-SA-4.0 notices are retained in README.md and source-manifest.json.

unsupportedBooks.TOB: The upstream standard-mappings README explicitly states that no Vulgate-to-Septuagint mappings are supplied for these books because their Vorlage differs. Absence of a rule must not become identity.

groupMappings.provenance: Wycliffe-Zefania LAO review 2026-10-30: native verse 15 starts the list of qualities; verse 16 finishes it and adds the instruction to retain what was heard. The reference list is verse 15 and the retention instruction verse 16. Preserve the complete two-verse passage.
